name: paperclip
description: Paperclip provider module: the vendored planning / status-report workflow module's inference surface, speaking the OpenAI-compatible chat/completions wire shape shared with the deepseek and openai adapters, with cloud-to-local (Ollama) graceful degradation.

features.desc: OpenAI-compatible chat/completions chat with Bearer auth and typed output validation.
The paperclip-planner model id is a default illustrative identifier for the vendored module, overridable per tenant via the model mapping.
Cloud-to-local fallback to the keyless local Ollama hop when the primary is unavailable.

provenance.note: Gateway-owned module-catalog entry (issue #349) for the registered `paperclip` provider adapter. Pattern only; the OpenAI-compatible provider-gateway shape shared with the deepseek/openai adapters was re-implemented for this repo's Python substrate, no source file was copied.
